runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 11:28 sweep across 12 actually searched source families. No promotion-grade unique LIVE item was added. Direct Foxelli remote support is Slovakia-eligible but requires fluent/near-native spoken English and phone-based support/upsell experience. Kariera surfaced a new Bratislava 20 h/week assistant role, but the canonical detail requires English C1-C2 and high Excel/Word, so it was rejected. Upwork produced several Worldwide WordPress/e-commerce/VA hits, but visible candidates were stale, severely underbudgeted, country-restricted, excessive-hours, strong-English or development-heavy. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 verifiable hiring posts.

developmentChanges.title: Canonical language-depth check before promotion
developmentChanges.reason: Search snippets often hide decisive language requirements. Require canonical-detail extraction of language level before ranking admin/support roles so attractive part-time or remote posts are rejected early when C1/C2 or fluent spoken English is mandatory.

developmentChanges.title: Effective hourly floor for fixed-price freelance work
developmentChanges.reason: Estimate realistic hours from scope and convert fixed budgets into an effective hourly rate before promotion. This automatically suppresses misleading WordPress/e-commerce jobs such as 120 monthly articles for 30 USD or full e-commerce builds for tens of dollars.
